pack.title: Major Arcana: reflective prompts
pack.ordering: Rider-Waite-Smith order; Strength VIII and Justice XI
pack.content: Traditional card titles with original upright reflective prompts

candidates.title: The Fool
candidates.interpretation: What beginning asks for curiosity before certainty, and what risk can remain bounded?

candidates.title: The Magician
candidates.interpretation: Which available skill or tool becomes effective when you give it undivided attention?

candidates.title: The High Priestess
candidates.interpretation: What is not yet ready to be explained, and what can be learned by listening longer?

candidates.title: The Empress
candidates.interpretation: What needs material care, patience, or room to grow?

candidates.title: The Emperor
candidates.interpretation: Which boundary or structure would make action safer and clearer?

candidates.title: The Hierophant
candidates.interpretation: Which inherited practice is teaching you, and which part deserves examination?

candidates.title: The Lovers
candidates.interpretation: What choice would align relationship, desire, and stated values?

candidates.title: The Chariot
candidates.interpretation: What competing impulses need one direction before momentum becomes useful?

candidates.title: Strength
candidates.interpretation: Where would patient courage accomplish more than force?

candidates.title: The Hermit
candidates.interpretation: What becomes audible when you step back from other people's urgency?

candidates.title: Wheel of Fortune
candidates.interpretation: Which change is already in motion, and where can you respond without pretending to control it?

candidates.title: Justice
candidates.interpretation: What consequence, obligation, or imbalance needs an exact accounting?

candidates.title: The Hanged Man
candidates.interpretation: What changes when you stop forcing movement and examine the situation from its underside?

candidates.title: Death
candidates.interpretation: What ending must be acknowledged before transformation becomes more than a slogan?

candidates.title: Temperance
candidates.interpretation: Which elements need proportion, exchange, and repeated adjustment rather than a dramatic solution?

candidates.title: The Devil
candidates.interpretation: Which attachment gains power by remaining unnamed, and what choice would loosen it?

candidates.title: The Tower
candidates.interpretation: What unstable structure is being exposed, and what truth survives its collapse?

candidates.title: The Star
candidates.interpretation: What small source of orientation can you trust while repair is still incomplete?

candidates.title: The Moon
candidates.interpretation: Which fear, image, or ambiguity needs observation before it is treated as fact?

candidates.title: The Sun
candidates.interpretation: What becomes simpler when it is brought fully into view and shared?

candidates.title: Judgement
candidates.interpretation: What prior decision is asking to be heard, revised, or answered now?

candidates.title: The World
candidates.interpretation: What is actually complete, and what new threshold appears when you name that completion?
